content:
Apple has recently raised the prices of most of its products, but products like the iPhone are expected to see further price increases next month.

The iPhone 18 series is expected to undergo price hikes, and Apple Watch and AirPods may also be affected

Earlier this summer, Apple raised the prices of a range of products.

Mac, iPad, Apple TV, HomePod, and Vision Pro all saw price increases at the same time.

CEO Tim Cook had warned earlier that price hikes were coming, but it was still surprising to see such a large-scale price increase across so many products all at once.

The flagship products that were unaffected in this first round of price hikes include:

  • iPhone
  • Apple Watch
  • AirPods

At the time, Apple hinted that more price increases would follow. Analysts also believed that the few products that initially escaped would soon face price hikes as well.

Now, with the September iPhone 18 launch event approaching, the market widely expects the iPhone to see a price increase.

According to rumors, the starting price of the iPhone 18 Pro will range from US$1,299 to US$1,399, compared to US$1,099 for the iPhone 17 Pro.

Apple usually lowers the prices of older iPhone models when new ones are released. However, this year older models are expected to maintain their original prices or see slight increases.

The Apple Watch Series 12 and Ultra 4 may also be targets for price hikes, as the current AI-driven memory shortage will also affect the cost of watch components.

Finally, AirPods may also see price increases. Although the likelihood is lower than for iPhone and Apple Watch, as rising memory and storage chip costs have a relatively smaller impact on AirPods.

But if Apple plans to raise prices across its entire product lineup, including AirPods, this will become apparent at the September launch event.

What price increases do you expect from Apple? Feel free to let us know in the comments section.
